purpose: User-requested minimal-credit Higgsfield game visual redesign

params.prompt: Original premium family adventure game art, handcrafted miniature clay diorama, tactile matte ceramic and felt-like moss, rounded sculpted forms, rich jade greens, ochre clay, warm honey sunlight, soft ambient occlusion, charming and polished, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. A production-ready transparent sprite atlas of exactly FOUR original adorable Silla-inspired fired-clay animal toy companions, arranged in a precise 2 by 2 grid of equal square cells. TOP LEFT: a squat friendly ochre TOAD with small bumpy cheeks and stout legs. TOP RIGHT: a relaxed terracotta SNAKE with a coiled body and gently raised head. BOTTOM LEFT: a sturdy small TURTLE with muted jade ceramic shell, ochre clay head and four feet. BOTTOM RIGHT: a plump little BIRD with ochre clay body, dark teal wing tips and spread wings. Full-body front three-quarter views, small shiny black bead eyes, handmade thumbprint surface, subtle individual personalities, collectible toy quality. Each animal centered inside its own quadrant with ample transparent padding, never crossing central horizontal or vertical divider. Identical lighting and style on all four. No accessories, no ground plane, no scenery, no drawn grid, no frames, no labels, no text. All backgrounds fully transparent. Soft minimal contact shadow only under each creature. Clearly readable silhouettes. These are fictional characters, not replicas of excavated objects.

assets.processing: Original opaque image; hand-traced Canvas paths in src/clay-art.js isolate four characters. No paid background-removal service.
